title: Glow Yoga at Tap Yard - but make it SPOOKY!
description: The freaks are flowing at Tap Yard for Glow Yoga - Halloween Edition!
long_description:
The freaks are flowing at Tap Yard for Glow Yoga - Halloween Edition!

About this Event

We're already in the Halloween spirit & ready to flow with our favorite ghouls! Halloween costumes & other themed attire highly encouraged, but not required. Glow in the dark body paint & other accessories provided!
6pm-6.45pm - Arrive at Tap Yard to grab a drink & get as decorated as you'd like for class
7pm - All levels yoga class. We'll take some time to ground ourselves & breathe before enjoying a yoga practice centered on mobility, awareness & embodiment & then slow things down with some juicy stretches at the end.
8pm - Class ends! Tap Yard will be open for you to grab a drink & hang out as long as you'd like.

Community-Based Pricing We believe yoga should be accessible to all! Choose the rate that feels right for you.
Pay What You Can: $15 For anyone who needs yoga without financial stress
I can Pay (Sustainer Rate): $25 Covers your class and supports our teachers
I can support (Contributor rate): $35 Pays it forward to keep community yoga accessible

Also check out other in Raleigh, Health & Wellness events in Raleigh, Workshops in Raleigh.
